key_insight: Sage-Taiyi uses explicit metacognitive monitoring and control to revise scientific understanding and guide what to investigate next.
engineering_relevance: The architecture could help materials and engineering researchers prioritize research targets and select reusable reasoning methods for experimental or computational validation.
method: Monitor evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions.
Adapt research targets using accumulated scientific understanding.
Select reusable reasoning methods to guide investigations.
evidence_signal: Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight Taiyi-Bench metrics across 265 tasks from 50 papers in ten disciplines, scoring 54.0 overall versus 47.9 for AI Scientist-v2; five expert-guided collaborations connect proposals to experimental and computational validation.
watch_item: Ideation benchmark gains and expert-guided validations do not yet establish reliable autonomous discovery across materials research workflows.
paper_title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
